seo.description: Fit-only Lefroy Brooks installation in Sunningdale — exposed-pipework taps and shower valves fitted to be seen. £125 survey, installs from £3,500.

h1: Lefroy Brooks bathroom installation in Sunningdale

hero.intro: Sunningdale is better known for its golf courses than its bathrooms, but the large detached properties that surround those courses — Victorian and Edwardian houses, inter-war family homes and more recent executive-style builds, many on private or gated roads — are exactly the kind of homes where Lefroy Brooks's traditional brassware belongs. Its exposed pipework, cross-head handles and period-inspired profiles are built to be seen, not boxed in, which asks more of the installation than most modern, concealed fittings do. We fit Lefroy Brooks taps, shower valves and sanitaryware across Sunningdale, setting out every pipe run, bracket and wall fixing to be looked at rather than hidden behind tiling.

sections.heading: Lefroy Brooks: brassware built to be seen
sections.body: Most modern brassware is designed to disappear — concealed valves, minimal plates, pipework chased into the wall before anyone sees it. Lefroy Brooks works the opposite way. Its traditional-style taps, shower valves and sanitaryware are built around exposed pipework, cross-head handles and period-inspired profiles, which means the pipe runs, brackets and wall fixings aren't something to hide — they're part of what the room looks like once it's finished. Every joint, every bracket, every length of visible pipe has to be set out and finished properly, because there's no tiled wall or boxed-in panel to cover a mistake. For a fit-only installer, that changes the order of operations: first-fix has to anticipate exactly where each exposed run will sit before any tiling goes on, not after.

sections.heading: What we install from the Lefroy Brooks range
sections.body: We fit Lefroy Brooks exposed-pipework shower valves and risers, cross-head basin and bath taps, freestanding bath fillers, and the brand's traditional sanitaryware, as part of a fit-only service — you choose and buy the Lefroy Brooks pieces, we handle strip-out, first-fix, tiling, plumbing and snagging. Because the pipework is on display rather than concealed, we set out bracket positions and pipe runs at first-fix stage with the finished look already decided, so the tiler and plumber are working to the same reference points rather than correcting each other's work later.

sections.heading: Why Sunningdale's plots suit this kind of installation
sections.body: Sunningdale's housing stock — the Victorian and Edwardian houses, inter-war family homes and executive-style builds that sit around its golf courses, many on private or gated roads — tends to come with generous plot sizes. That matters for exposed-pipework brassware more than people expect, because it usually means more flexibility on layout than a terraced or semi-detached property would allow. Moving a waste run three feet to accommodate a freestanding bath with a Lefroy Brooks floor-standing filler, for example, is rarely constrained by a neighbouring structure the way it would be in a tighter semi — which gives us more room to position the bath where the exposed pipework reads well, rather than wherever the existing plumbing happens to be.

sections.heading: The fit-only process: survey, install, price
sections.body: Every project starts with a paid survey, £125, where we check the room, the existing pipework and waste positions, and how a Lefroy Brooks installation specifically will sit — because exposed brassware needs decisions made before first-fix, not during tiling. From there, installation starts from £3,500 and covers strip-out, first-fix plumbing, tiling, final fix and snagging. You buy the Lefroy Brooks taps, shower valves, sanitaryware, tiles and furniture directly; we don't mark up materials or sell products — we're a fit-only installer, so the price you pay us is for the work, not a supplier margin.

sections.heading: Book a Lefroy Brooks survey in Sunningdale
sections.body: If you've chosen Lefroy Brooks for a bathroom in Sunningdale, or you're deciding between exposed and concealed brassware for a period or executive-style property, call or WhatsApp 07399 651836 to arrange a £125 survey. We'll look at the room, talk through how the exposed pipework will be set out, and give you a clear installation price from £3,500.

faqs.q: Do you supply Lefroy Brooks products, or do I buy them myself?
faqs.a: We're fit-only — you buy the Lefroy Brooks taps, shower valves, sanitaryware, tiles and furniture yourself, from wherever you choose, and we handle the installation: strip-out, first-fix, tiling, plumbing and snagging.

faqs.q: Why does exposed pipework brassware need a different installation approach?
faqs.a: Lefroy Brooks's traditional-style fittings are built around exposed pipework, cross-head handles and period-inspired profiles rather than concealed, minimal fittings — so every pipe run, bracket and wall fixing is visible once the room is finished and has to be set out and finished properly rather than hidden behind tiling.

faqs.q: Will my plot size affect what's possible with a freestanding bath?
faqs.a: Often, yes, in a good way. Sunningdale's detached properties tend to sit on generous plots, which usually gives more flexibility on layout than a terraced or semi-detached house — moving a waste run a few feet to accommodate a freestanding bath is rarely constrained by a neighbouring structure.

faqs.q: How much does a Lefroy Brooks installation cost?
faqs.a: Installations start from £3,500, following a £125 paid survey. The exact price depends on the scope of work — strip-out, first-fix, tiling, plumbing and snagging — and how much exposed pipework needs setting out.

faqs.q: Do you work on gated or private roads in Sunningdale?
faqs.a: Yes — a number of Sunningdale properties sit on private or gated roads, and we coordinate access as part of the standard survey and installation process.

faqs.q: Do you do repairs on existing Lefroy Brooks fittings?
faqs.a: We take on repairs for high-end homes, minimum £200, with a £500 minimum for emergency call-outs. We don't do regrouting.
